Overview

This is a two-bedroom, two-bathroom condo for rent at Aurora Pratumnak, on Pratumnak Hill in Pattaya. The unit has 70 sqm of living area and is on the 5th floor. It is offered fully furnished at ฿22,000 THB per month, with a minimum lease of 12 months.

Aurora Pratumnak is a completed condominium developed by DJP Land & House Co., Ltd. It has 117 units and was finished in the fourth quarter of 2016.

Location & Lifestyle

Aurora Pratumnak sits on Pratumnak Hill, and the distances below are measured from the building. Big Buddha Hill (Wat Phra Yai) is about 960 m away, and Pratumnak Beach is about 1.1 km. Bali Hai Pier is about 1.2 km from the building, and Dong Tan Beach is about 1.5 km.

Walking Street is about 1.7 km away, and Tukcom Pattaya is about 1.9 km. Together these give a clear picture of what lies around the building: temple and beach areas to one side, the pier, and the city's nightlife and shopping destinations further along.

Layout & Interior

The unit is laid out with two bedrooms and two bathrooms within 70 sqm of living area. It sits on the 5th floor and is rented fully furnished, so the apartment comes equipped as listed rather than empty.

Ownership & Investment

This unit is offered as a rental. The monthly rent is ฿22,000 THB, and the minimum lease is 12 months. A tenant taking the apartment commits to a year in a two-bedroom, two-bathroom, 70 sqm home on the 5th floor of a building completed in 2016.
